slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: The Data Landscapers review states that rural primary schools in Uganda predominantly record administrative data, attendance and learning outcomes in paper registers, with daily attendance manual and aggregated on paper and no evidence of a majority of rural schools using digital tools routinely; the review gives no date for this, so its publication date is used.

systems.tiers: head teachers fill paper forms, sent to District Education Offices and keyed into national EMIS; collection stalled after 2017
national; keyed from Annual School Census forms
termly paper tools digitised at district level in 10 of 175 sites since 2019, including Gulu and Entebbe
